title: How to Build a Sales Practice Culture Reps Actually Use
summary: Use this four-week plan to build a sales practice culture with leader participation, focused drills, useful feedback, retries, and live-call evidence.
body_markdown:
Week


Team action


Manager action


Evidence to keep


1. Model


Leader runs one scenario and retry


Learn the debrief and scoring anchors


Questions and scoring disagreements


2. Pilot


One rep group runs a private attempt


Review one flagged moment per rep


Participation, retry rate, and transcript evidence


3. Calibrate


Two managers score the same attempts


Resolve criterion wording and anchors


Scoring variance and rule changes


4. Connect


Choose a drill from recent call evidence


Check for the target behavior in later calls


Practice-to-call examples and next coaching action
